AROMA Cafe Bistro Bar Phu Quoc sits inside Happy Bear Hostel on 179 30/4 Street and somehow stays off the radar. Great coffee, solid food, $15-30 a head. No resort markup. No tourist-trap energy. Just a spot that earns a near-perfect rating the honest way. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
